Judah Lewis is an American actor who started working as a child/teen performer and is best known for leading roles in a run of high‑profile genre movies on Netflix.

Notable credits
- The Babysitter (2017, Netflix) – Plays Cole Johnson, the bullied teen who discovers his babysitter (Samara Weaving) is part of a satanic cult. Breakout role; directed by McG.
- The Babysitter: Killer Queen (2020, Netflix) – Reprises Cole in the sequel.
- The Christmas Chronicles (2018, Netflix) – Plays Teddy Pierce, opposite Kurt Russell as Santa.
- The Christmas Chronicles 2 (2020, Netflix) – Returns as Teddy (supporting).
- Demolition (2015) – With Jake Gyllenhaal and Naomi Watts; Lewis plays Chris, Karen’s (Watts) son.
- Summer of 84 (2018) – An ’80s‑set thriller; he plays Tommy “Eats” Eaton, one of the quartet of teen friends.
- I See You (2019) – A twisty thriller with Helen Hunt; he plays Alec, a teen “phrogger” secretly living in a family’s home.

Career notes
- Frequently associated with teen/young‑adult genre projects (horror, thriller, holiday adventure), several released by Netflix, which helped build his audience internationally.
- Drew early industry attention when trade reports in 2015 placed him on a shortlist of young actors testing for Marvel/Sony’s Spider‑Man: Homecoming (the role ultimately went to Tom Holland).

Public persona and reception
- Often praised for conveying vulnerability and resilience in coming‑of‑age and suspense settings (e.g., The Babysitter films and Summer of 84).
- Maintains a relatively low public profile outside of projects; no widely reported controversies or major award campaigns as of the last few years.
